_note: Arrow wounds on werewolves and werebears: shafts buried in fur and heavy muscle, often snapped off. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point punching through the fur into the hide. The shaft quivers there and {name} snarls and recoils, hackles up.
, the arrowhead tearing into hide that is already torn. Blood wells around the shaft under the matted fur and {name} howls. The smell of blood and wet fur thickens.
